reference.body: wall-sided box barge, closed in the bilge; second curve GZ = 0.3 sin(2 phi)

claims.claim: the flooding angle replaces 40 deg and both areas cut at theta_f match the antiderivative (code 2.2.1b/2.2.1c, sibling 2.2.2/2.2.3)
claims.expected: upper limit 35 deg, both areas inside 5e-4 / 2e-3 relative (1 deg trapezoid on the barge)
claims.name: area_limits_with_flooding_angle

claims.claim: theta_f is actually used, not accepted and ignored
claims.measured: A(0,40) = 0.152730850 without theta_f vs 0.110405289 at theta_f = 35 deg (difference 4.23e-02 m rad)
claims.expected: 40 deg used when theta_f is omitted; the two areas differ by more than 1e-3 m rad
claims.name: flooding_angle_is_substituted

claims.claim: gust area b over [theta_1, theta_2] matches the antiderivative of GZ
claims.expected: theta_2 = 50 deg (the code's cap), b inside 1e-3 relative of the antiderivative on a 1 deg grid
claims.name: gust_area_b

claims.claim: gust area a is lw2 times the span (the lever is constant)
claims.expected: rel < 1e-12: exact geometry, no quadrature involved
claims.name: gust_area_a

claims.claim: theta_2 is the least of the 50 deg, down-flooding and flooding caps
claims.measured: no cap but the code's 50 deg: theta_2 = 50.0 deg, b rel 2.27e-04; down-flooding at 38 deg: theta_2 = 38.0 deg, b rel 1.72e-04; flooding angle 35 deg: theta_2 = 35.0 deg, b rel 1.63e-04
claims.expected: theta_2 equals the binding cap in all three cases and b stays inside 2e-3 relative of the antiderivative

rows.cap: no cap but the code's 50 deg

claims.name: theta2_is_the_least_cap

claims.claim: the second intercept theta_c is solved right and b is measured to it
claims.expected: |theta_c - bisection| < 5e-3 deg, b inside 1e-3 relative, theta_2 = theta_c because the cap is 50 deg
claims.name: second_intercept

claims.claim: 2.3.2 passes below the analytic lever where b = a and fails above it
claims.measured: b = a at lw1 = 0.212270866 m; margin +2.936e-04 at -0.1 % (2.3.2 satisfied True) and -2.621e-04 at +0.1 % (satisfied False); reported margin vs b - a rel 0.0e+00
claims.expected: margin positive below the crossing, negative above, equal to b - a to 1e-6 relative, verdict flags following the sign
claims.name: gust_boundary

claims.claim: 2.3.3 at equality passes, one step above fails, and the empty span reports no areas rather than a zero
claims.measured: theta_1 = theta_f = 20 deg: 2.3.3 satisfied True (margin 0.0); theta_1 = 20.5 deg: satisfied False (margin -0.5); areas at equality b = None, a = None; at theta_1 = 8 deg b = 0.027178862
claims.expected: equality passes with margin 0, 20.5 deg fails, and the empty theta_2 - theta_1 span is reported as None (not 0) for both areas
claims.name: roll_amplitude_boundary

claims.claim: both implementations of 2.2 land on the same closed form at theta_f = 35
claims.measured: statutory A(0,35) = 0.110387295151 (rel 6.98e-09, its own uncertainty 1.80e-05); sibling = 0.110405289 (rel 1.63e-04); spread 1.63e-04
claims.expected: statutory inside 1e-7 relative (adaptive Simpson on the wall-sided curve), sibling inside 5e-4 (1 deg trapezoid), spread inside 5e-4
claims.name: cross_module

claims.claim: the gust-area residual falls as the step squared (trapezoid signature)
claims.measured: errors 5.70e-03 at 5.0 deg, 1.43e-03 at 2.5 deg, 3.58e-04 at 1.25 deg, 8.94e-05 at 0.625 deg; successive ratios 3.98, 4.00, 4.00
claims.expected: successive ratios in 3.5-4.5 from 2.5 deg down, i.e. O(h^2), so the residual is the grid and not the rule
claims.name: grid_convergence
